purpose: Self-governance contract for sovereign code lifecycle, isolated worktrees, Forgejo PR actuation, and verified promotion gates.
principles: Machine-readable first: lifecycle states and transitions are strictly typed data, never prose or manual assumptions.
Zero-I/O pure domain core: evaluation of merge eligibility, branch state, and worktree health is purely functional.
No mutation without read-back proof: any git actuation (worktree allocation, PR merge, relay push) must be observed and proven.
Shared worktree isolation: concurrent agents must never mutate shared HEAD; isolated worktrees are mandatory on Cortex.

worktree_isolation.allocation_rule: Every agent task must allocate an isolated git worktree branched from verified origin/main.
forbidden_actions: git checkout on shared repository HEAD
git add -A / git add . in shared worktree
